text: dsh-wikilink 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的维基链接插件，可在输入框输入 [[ 后搜索工作区 Markdown 笔记。它在会话工作区建立笔记标题索引，并通过输入覆盖层显示匹配列表；选择标题后，发送前会把唯一匹配的笔记内容附加给模型。支持标题与路径的模糊匹配、多词搜索、设置页启停和索引状态提示。适合需要在 DSH 对话中引用项目笔记的用户。无需额外账号或密钥；可通过配置限制索引数量、单文件大小和忽略目录。

dsh-wikilink adds Obsidian-style note references to DSH Web. Type [[ to search workspace Markdown titles, then select a note to append its contents before the model step. It supports fuzzy and multi-term matching, an enable switch, and index status. No account or API key is needed.
我想在 DSH 输入框里按笔记标题搜索并引用 Markdown 文件。
让 DSH 能用双中括号把工作区笔记内容带进对话。
DSH 能不能根据我输入的几个关键词筛选笔记标题？
我希望在聊天里提到一篇项目说明时，模型能读到它的正文。
DSH 输入时没有笔记建议，怎样快速找到工作区里的 Markdown 文档？
I want to mention a workspace note in a DSH message and include its contents for the model.
Can I find Markdown notes by typing part of their title in the composer?
想让聊天发送前自动把我链接的笔记正文补充到上下文里。
dsh-wikilink 的功能「笔记标题选择器」：在 DSH 输入框键入未闭合的 [[ 或【【时显示候选笔记。插件按标题和相对路径匹配，并可用空格分隔多个必须同时匹配的词；按 Enter 可插入闭合的标题链接。
dsh-wikilink 的功能「发送时附加笔记」：发送前识别用户消息中的 [[...]]，按唯一标题或精确相对路径解析工作区 Markdown 文件，并将文件正文作为额外用户消息交给模型；无法唯一解析的链接保持为普通文本。
dsh-wikilink 的功能「工作区笔记索引」：服务端为当前会话工作区列出 Markdown 文件并去掉扩展名作为标题。可配置索引条目上限、单文件读取大小上限和忽略目录；客户端缓存索引并显示索引状态。
dsh-wikilink 使用前须知：引用的笔记正文会随消息附加给模型；超过单文件大小上限的笔记无法读取（见 src/mention.ts:148-155、src/files.ts:176-189）。

dsh-wikilink README · dsh-wikilink：Obsidian-style `[[wikilink]]` mentions for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI. Type `[[` in the composer and a note-title picker floats up: fuzzy search your workspace notes as you type — including **out-of-order (subsequence) matches** (「曼食」 finds 曼谷街头美食文化观察) and **space-separated multi-term matches** (「曼谷 美食」 finds 曼谷街头美食文化观察 / 曼谷笔记：美食 / 曼谷朱拉隆功夜市美食探索). Press Enter to attach, and the referenced note content ships to the model when the message is sent.

dsh-wikilink README · dsh-wikilink：```
composer:  summarize  [[曼谷 美.    ← picker over the open token
            ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
            │ 📄 曼谷街头美食文化观察：鱼鳔老太太摊位的夜间消费场景          │
            │ 📄 曼谷笔记：美食                                     │

Type `[[query` and the picker opens exactly on the double bracket; Enter replaces the token with `[[title]]` and the caret lands after `]]` (Obsidian-style). A single `[` in prose never triggers it.

dsh-wikilink README · No harness patches needed：Earlier versions patched the installed `@deepseek-ai` client bundles to make the `[[` trigger work (the harness input pipeline only recognizes `/` and `@`). Since v0.2 the picker is fully self-drawn: the plugin watches the draft itself, renders its own floating menu on the public `conversation.input.overlay` slot, and writes the closed `[[title]]` back through the public input actions. **No patches, no re-apply step — install, restart, done.**

dsh-wikilink README · Install：> **Compatibility**: v0.2.1+ requires **dsh ≥ 0.1.2-rc.1**. dsh 0.1.2-rc.1 removed the `settingsNamespace()` factory from `@deepseek-ai/dsh-settings`; the plugin registers its `wikilink` namespace as a plain string literal since v0.2.1 (it still runs on older dsh releases — the string form was always the underlying wire format).

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/zhaoscsc/dsh-wikilink/archive/refs/heads/main.tar.gz
```
dsh-wikilink README · Install：Restart the web server so the host half and the served client bundle pick up the plugin. The enable switch lives in **Settings → Wikilinks**.

dsh-wikilink README · Configuration：Host-side tunables on the plugin row in the profile patch layer:

```yaml
- id: dsh-wikilink
  config:
    maxIndexedFiles: 100000   # hard cap on indexed entries (large vaults need this)
    maxFileBytes: 262144      # hard cap on one attached note; larger files are refused

The index is cached per session for 30 seconds; an index-status strip above the composer reports indexing in progress / done (with the note count) / failed.

dsh-wikilink README · Model experience：| Aspect | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| Token cost | One attached note adds its complete content (up to `maxFileBytes`) to the request. |
| Tool calls | None — the content is already in the prompt. |
| Message format | Each note serializes as `<note path="…" title="…">…</note>`, injected as a user-role message with source `wikilink-mention`. |
| Resolution | `[[dir/title]]` resolves by exact path; `[[title]]` resolves only when the title is unique; unresolvable or ambiguous tokens stay plain prose. |

dsh-wikilink README · Matching：Four tiers over the note title (then the relative path): contiguous substring > subsequence (out-of-order) > path substring > path subsequence. Queries split on whitespace must all match (AND). Both query and titles are NFC-normalized.

Real examples from a travel-note vault:

dsh-wikilink README · Matching：| Query | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `[[曼谷 美食]]` | 曼谷街头美食文化观察：鱼鳔老太太摊位的夜间消费场景 · 曼谷笔记：美食 · 曼谷朱拉隆功夜市美食探索 |
| `[[曼食]]` (out-of-order) | 曼谷**街**头美**食**文化观察（matches across skipped characters) |
| `[[鱼鳔]]` | 曼谷街头美食文化观察：鱼鳔老太太摊位的夜间消费场景 |

dsh-wikilink README · Known limitations：- The picker triggers on the last unclosed `[[`/`【【` anywhere in the draft, with the query running to the draft end — the public input state carries no caret info, so caret-not-at-end doesn't trigger.
- The self-drawn menu is styled and key-handled by the plugin itself, so it evolves independently from the `/` and `@` pipeline menus.
- The workspace index is cached per session for 30 seconds; files created later appear on the next menu open after that window.
- A note literally named `.md` is skipped (its empty title would fail the wire schema).
- **IME caveat:** some Chinese input methods (Sogou, WeChat, Baidu, system Pinyin, …) have a **symbol auto-completion** feature (smart punctuation / bracket auto-pairing) that auto-inserts a closing bracket when you type `[` or `【` (`[` → `[]`, `【` → `【】`). That breaks the double-open detection and the picker never opens. **Disable symbol auto-completion in the input method settings** (it may be called smart punctuation / bracket auto-pairing / symbol suggestion).

dsh-wikilink README · Development：```sh
node build.mjs        # esbuild is vendored under ./node_modules; zod is inlined into the client bundle
```

See [DEV.md](DEV.md) for the architecture (self-drawn picker — no harness patches) and the build/dev loop.
